annotations.title: Everything on file about a person

description: Everything on file about one person, in sections: what they have done, who they work with, how they are spoken about, what they have written or said in public, and what has been in the news about them lately. Broader than a short brief and not written for any one purpose — this is the file, not the verdict. Use it for "tell me everything about her", "what am I walking into with this person", "is this creator worth working with", "background on him before the call". If you only need an email, ask for their contact details instead — that is far cheaper. If a short written assessment is what you want, ask for a brief. If the name matches more than one person you get the candidates and nothing is charged; nothing is charged when nobody matches.Costs 30 credits the first time, and nothing at all if you have looked this person up before.

company.description: Optional. Where they work, so a common name finds the right person, for example "Acme".

format.description: summary: the most useful sections only. full: every section that has something in it.

name.description: The full name of the person, for example "Jane Doe". Give either name or person_id.

person_id.description: The id of one person from the candidate list an earlier call returned, when the name matched several people. Give either name or person_id.

refresh.description: Set true only to build the file again from scratch instead of returning the one already on file; that is charged again.

name: get_dossier

candidates.description: People or companies the name could mean, each with an id and enough to tell them apart. Nothing is charged for this list.

credits_charged.description: Credits this call took. 0 when nothing was charged.

enriched_at.description: When the file was last built (ISO date and time).

error.description: Present when the call could not do the work; says why and that nothing was charged where that is so.

markdown_content.description: The file, as text with headings.

message.description: A plain note about the answer, for example why candidates were returned instead of a result.

person_profile_id.description: The id of this person's file; pass it to export_report to make a sendable copy.

pricing_note.description: What this call cost and what a repeat costs.

retry_with_param.description: The input to send on the next call with the chosen candidate.

share_url.description: A link to the file you can share.

status.description: "needs_disambiguation" when the name matched more than one person; pick one and call again with its person_id.

word_count.description: Length of the file in words.
